description: This file defines the MediaEffectsFragment class, a fragment in an Android application responsible for applying various media effects to an image using OpenGL ES and the Android Effect framework. It manages rendering, effect initialization, texture handling, and user interaction for selecting effects.

classes.name: MediaEffectsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides an interface for applying different graphical effects to an image using OpenGL ES and the Android Effect framework. It manages the lifecycle, rendering, effect selection, and texture handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting options menu visibility.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Associates views and sets up the GLSurfaceView renderer and options.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for effect selection.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections to change effects and trigger re-rendering.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL context, loads textures, applies selected effects, and renders the result each frame.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the selected effect based on user input.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates OpenGL textures, loads bitmap, and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Creates an Effect object based on the current effect selection and sets parameters accordingly.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the current effect to the input texture, rendering to an output texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Displays the processed or original texture on the screen.
